question_asked: Does any committed scoring key compute WCF on a base that disagrees with the engine -- specifically, does any assume an ANNUAL rather than a monthly base?
verdict: INCUMBENT CONFIRMED. Every parsed key uses the monthly base and agrees with compute_wcf() exactly. No shared wrong assumption, so no inflated failure count from this cause.

primary_source.base: asilimia 0.5 ya mapato ghafi; mapato ghafi = mshahara + posho 'sambamba na mshahara wa KILA MWEZI'
primary_source.cadence: 'michango ya kila mwezi', remitted within the month or the next
primary_source.the_annual_item_on_the_same_page: 'Kuwasilisha taarifa za mapato ya mwaka ya wafanyakazi' -- an annual REPORTING duty, a different obligation from the contribution base. Named because this is the likeliest origin of the annual reading.

what_it_cannot_show: Whether the portal's Swahili FAQ faithfully summarises the Act. The regulator's own summary is not the statute (see CLAUDE.md, the Class A transport row TRA prints that FA2024 does not contain). WCA s.79 was NOT read -- it appears nowhere in this repository and no copy was located.
why_this_population: Every committed scoring key that states a WCF calculation, which is the population a wrong base assumption would corrupt. A wrong key is invisible to adjudication because the adjudication reads the key (eval_347 / eval_355 / tg_08).

rows.question: Duka letu lina wafanyakazi kumi na mbili, mshahara wa kila mmoja ni laki nne. Tunataka kujua makato yote matatu -- mafunzo, uzeeni, na ajali kazini.
mishahara yangu yote kwa mwezi ni milioni 3 nichangie ngapi kwenye ile ya fidia
nina saluni thamani ya vifaa vyangu ni milioni 20 na nawalipa wafanyakazi jumla ya milioni 2 kwa mwezi nichangie ngapi kwenye ile ya fidia za wafanyakazi
Robo tatu ya wafanyakazi 16 wanapata TZS 450,000, robo wanapata TZS 1,000,000 — WCF ya jumla?
Nina mfanyakazi mmoja tu anayelipwa TZS 500,000, je bado nachangia WCF?
Nilipe SDL, NSSF, PAYE na WCF kwa mfanyakazi mmoja mwenye TZS 800,000 — nionyeshe vyote.
Nina maswali: mishahara ni TZS 3,200,000 kwa watu 8, nataka SDL, NSSF na WCF, na pia je nawajibika kusajili OSHA?
Nina wafanyakazi 10, kati yao 4 wana mishahara ya TZS 700,000 na 6 wana TZS 300,000, nataka WCF na SDL — zote mbili.
